title: DEX aggregator architecture spec: routing, allowlist, TOA feed, min_out
description:
Deliverable: docs/architecture/P16_DEX_AGG_ARCHITECTURE.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) the multi-split routing engine, on-chain venue allowlist registry, off-chain TOA forecast feed hook, and min_out protection policy are each specified; (2) every allowlisted Base venue onboarding step and the allowlist update procedure are named; (3) the exact slippage/min_out math is stated and reviewed against the catalog gates (min_out, venue_whitelist).
Constraints: fee 6 bps, risk_score 0.26, max_alloc_pct 0.50, live_blocked=true.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Router and venue-adapter interfaces plus Python quote dataclasses
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p16-dex-aggregator/interfaces/IDEXRouter.sol and IVenueAdapter.sol; QuoteRequest/RouteQuote dataclasses in src/sincor2/defi/p16_dex_aggregator/types.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24 with zero errors and zero warnings; (2) quote() is an exact view and swap() honors a caller-supplied minOut; (3) the Python dataclasses serialize round-trip through JSON.
Constraints: adapter quote tolerance 1 wei vs fork snapshot.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: 6 bps fee model to Treasury with worked multi-split examples
description:
Deliverable: fee model document: 6 bps on the input token of every executed swap, swept to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac.
Acceptance criteria: (1) a reviewer can compute the exact treasury take for any routed swap from the spec alone; (2) worked fee-math examples for multi-split routes included; (3) fee-on-transfer tokens handled by a measured-input (balance-before/after) rule.
Constraints: fee taken in the input token, same transaction as the swap.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Create P16 repo layout and skeletons
description:
Deliverable: onchain/src/p16-dex-aggregator/{interfaces,adapters,RouterGateway.sol}, src/sincor2/defi/p16_dex_aggregator/, tests/pytest/test_p16_dex_aggregator.py, agents/p16-dex-aggregator.yaml as an empty-but-valid skeleton with a module-map README.
Acceptance criteria: (1) directory tree exists; (2) YAML parses and validates; (3) no test collector errors from the new paths.
Constraints: layout mirrors the interface module map.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: RouterGateway skeleton and Python agent starter code
description:
Deliverable: RouterGateway.sol skeleton (ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, non-bricking try/catch around each venue call) plus a Python agent skeleton in src/sincor2/defi/p16_dex_aggregator/agent.py with error handling and a TOA hook stub.
Acceptance criteria: (1) contract compiles under solc 0.8.24; (2) agent imports and answers a health ping; (3) stub test green in CI.
Constraints: router defaults to dry-run quoting, never executing.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Venue adapter interface plus Uniswap V3/V4 and Aerodrome adapters
description:
Deliverable: IVenueAdapter plus production adapters for Uniswap V3/V4 and Aerodrome on Base.
Acceptance criteria: (1) compiles under solc 0.8.24; (2) adapter quotes match fork snapshots of real pools within 1-wei tolerance; (3) swap() honors a caller-supplied minOut on every path.
Constraints: fee tiers 5/30/100 bps for V3; volatile and stable curves for Aerodrome.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Multi-split route optimizer maximizing net output after gas
description:
Deliverable: split solver allocating input across allowlisted venues, in Python with an optional on-chain split verifier.
Acceptance criteria: (1) on 100 synthetic quote sets the optimizer never violates min_out and allocations always sum to 100%; (2) average net realized output beats best-single-venue routing; (3) objective is output minus gas minus fees, never gross output.
Constraints: max 3 splits per swap; dust legs under $10 never emitted; gas penalization per added leg.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: TOA slippage forecasts reweighting route selection
description:
Deliverable: Python agent consuming TOA slippage/forecast feeds per venue pair and reweighting route selection each cycle, with the forecast hook wired into the agent YAML.
Acceptance criteria: (1) a TOA forecast JSON showing venue degradation measurably shifts recommended route weights in an integration test; (2) hook wired via src/sincor2/forecasting_engine.py and the agent YAML; (3) stale forecasts excluded from weighting.
Constraints: forecast staleness cutoff 60s.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: On-chain min_out protection with committed-quote check
description:
Deliverable: min_out enforced in RouterGateway - the whole swap reverts if realized output falls below minOut adjusted by the configured slippage tolerance.
Acceptance criteria: (1) minOut committed at execution time from a fresh quote (same-tx re-quote or 1-block-fresh signed quote); (2) tests prove a revert on a manipulated quote and a pass on an honest one; (3) default slippage tolerance 50 bps.
Constraints: minOut = quoted x (1 - slippage_bps/10000); off-chain quotes never trusted without re-validation.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: 6 bps fee sweep to Treasury on every swap
description:
Deliverable: fee sweep in the input token to 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac on every executed swap, recorded in an on-chain fee ledger event.
Acceptance criteria: (1) a fork test asserts the treasury balance delta equals exactly 6 bps of input on a real routed swap; (2) fee-ledger event emitted per swap; (3) fee transfer failure reverts the swap.
Constraints: exactly 6 bps, not approximately; measured-input rule for fee-on-transfer tokens.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Venue allowlist registry with 24h timelock
description:
Deliverable: allowlist registry with admin add/remove behind a timelock; RouterGateway reverts on any non-allowlisted venue adapter.
Acceptance criteria: (1) removal takes effect only after the 24h timelock elapses; (2) an attempted swap through a removed venue reverts post-timelock; (3) add/remove events queryable for audit.
Constraints: genesis allowlist - Uniswap V3, Uniswap V4, Aerodrome on Base.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Router edge cases: venue isolation, dust, WETH path, reentrancy
description:
Deliverable: edge-case handling for failing venues, dust amounts, WETH wrap/unwrap, and reentrancy attempts.
Acceptance criteria: (1) a failing venue is isolated by try/catch so one revert never bricks the route - the failed leg's input is returned; (2) dust legs under $10 merged or dropped; (3) a reentrancy attempt against the callback path reverts; each case has a passing test.
Constraints: WETH wrap/unwrap inside the atomic transaction.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 unit tests: optimizer math, registry, fee math
description:
Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p16_dex_aggregator.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) 100% of new code paths in the optimizer and registry covered, all green; (2) split-sum and gas-penalization math tested on synthetic sets; (3) fee math tested to the wei.
Constraints: suite runs in CI under 5 minutes.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 integration tests: agent-to-router path with mocked venues
description:
Deliverable: end-to-end test - Python agent builds a route, calls RouterGateway against mocked venue adapters.
Acceptance criteria: (1) full agent-to-router path runs in CI with mocked venues; (2) min_out holds on every run; (3) the 6 bps treasury fee lands exactly.
Constraints: mocked venues deterministic; real-pool coverage left to the fork test.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 invariant and fuzz tests: minOut, fee, allowlist
description:
Deliverable: fuzz harness over routes, quotes, and venue states.
Acceptance criteria: (1) 10k fuzz runs with zero invariant violations; (2) invariants: any executed swap realizes >= minOut, fee taken equals exactly 6 bps, only allowlisted venues ever execute; (3) every counterexample fixed and recorded.
Constraints: seed corpus checked in for reproducibility.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Base mainnet-fork routing simulation on real pools
description:
Deliverable: fork simulation run with a report.
Acceptance criteria: (1) routed swaps simulated on a pinned Base mainnet fork against real Uniswap V3 and Aerodrome pools; (2) at least 5 real-pool swaps settle with realized output >= minOut; (3) treasury fee deltas correct on every swap.
Constraints: block pin documented; re-runnable by a reviewer.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 audit-prep package: flattened sources, natspec, threat model
description:
Deliverable: audit package with flattened sources, full natspec, threat model, and trust assumptions on off-chain components.
Acceptance criteria: (1) package passes the repo's audit-readiness checklist with zero missing artifacts; (2) threat model covers malicious venue adapter, stale TOA forecast, admin key compromise; (3) every gate maps to its enforcing line of code.
Constraints: code hash frozen and recorded.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Remediate P16 audit findings with regression tests
description:
Deliverable: fixes for every finding in the audit findings log, each with a regression test proving the fix.
Acceptance criteria: (1) findings log shows 100% closed with linked tests; (2) no new warnings introduced; (3) full suite passes on the remediated tree.
Constraints: no fix weakens min_out or the allowlist.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Optimize P16 gas costs with a documented gas report
description:
Deliverable: gas report for quote/execute paths with packed calldata and storage, redundant external calls removed.
Acceptance criteria: (1) documented gas report published; (2) routed-swap execution under 300k gas on the reference fork; (3) zero behavioral change across the test suite.
Constraints: no optimization may remove a require on the execution path.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 technical documentation: routing math, adapter onboarding, TOA schema
description:
Deliverable: technical docs covering routing math, venue adapter onboarding guide, TOA forecast schema, min_out/fee accounting.
Acceptance criteria: (1) a new builder can add a third Base venue adapter from the docs alone; (2) optimizer objective and constraints fully specified; (3) all references resolve.
Constraints: numeric parameters table matches the spec.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 agent YAML config and ops runbook
description:
Deliverable: agents/p16-dex-aggregator.yaml (budgets, memory, heartbeat, TOA hook) and docs/ops/P16_DEX_AGG_RUNBOOK.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) YAML validates against the repo agent schema; (2) runbook covers incident procedures for venue outages and forecast staleness; (3) runbook covers the top 5 failure modes with step-by-step responses.
Constraints: router defaults to dry-run quoting.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 dashboard and monitoring hooks with unknown-on-stale semantics
description:
Deliverable: monitoring hooks exposing route fill rate, realized vs forecast slippage, and treasury fee inflow.
Acceptance criteria: (1) hooks emit structured metrics feeding the SINCOR dashboard; (2) the feed reports unknown rather than healthy when data is stale, per STATUS_FEED_SCHEMA; (3) per-venue revert rate exposed.
Constraints: staleness > 60s marks values unknown.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 testnet deploy scripts for Base Sepolia
description:
Deliverable: scripts/defi/p16/deploy_testnet.py deploying RouterGateway, both venue adapters, and the allowlist registry.
Acceptance criteria: (1) contracts deployed and verified on Base Sepolia with seeded allowlist entries; (2) a test swap executes end-to-end on Sepolia; (3) script idempotent.
Constraints: Sepolia only; no mainnet addresses in scripts.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: P16 mainnet readiness checklist with evidence links
description:
Deliverable: mainnet readiness checklist document.
Acceptance criteria: (1) checklist signed off item-by-item with evidence links; (2) covers audit sign-off, timelock active, monitoring live, dry-run default confirmed, treasury address verified; (3) nothing deploys to mainnet until all items pass.
Constraints: live_blocked=true until every item passes.
Reference: per specs/p16-dex-aggregator.md §Acceptance criteria.
